messages:
jess-oncall: FYI GlidePay (tenant-glidepay) hit repeated 429s and latency spikes on dedicated pool dp-glide-1 starting ~06:10 UTC. Customers see scale up/down churn —pool +2 -> -2 every ~3m. Can SRE take a look? cx impact, they are seeing 5% request loss.

sam-customer-success: Customer reports errors for both chat and embeddings endpoints. Sent request IDs: r_279a1, r_279a2. They said it started after the morning traffic surge. Asked them to keep traffic steady for repro. :frowning:

observability-bot: Alert: autoscaler.pulse_rate high on pool dp-glide-1 (06:09-06:18 UTC). 18 scale events triggered, 14 rollbacks. 95th latency jitter > 1.2s.\
mike-sre: I'm pulling autoscaler logs now. Quick theory: noisy-tenant / bursty queue causing reclaiming of idle nodes then immediate re-queue triggers scale-up. Our current cooldown is 120s, smoothing window 30s — too aggressive for this workload.\
anya-eng: Agreed. Where is the scaling bound coming from? If it's queue_length we might want longer hysteresis and a higher min_replicas for dp-glide-1. Also check if prefetch/warmup is failing causing cold starts.\
mike-sre: Prometheus snippets I'm looking at: 
```
sum(rate(inference_requests_total{pool="dp-glide-1"}[30s])) by (tenant)
avg_over_time(autoscaler_desired_replicas{pool="dp-glide-1"}[5m])
```
Seeing spikes in requests per second for tenant-glidepay at the same time as replica churn.\
jess-oncall: Repro steps from my shell (from internal test):
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-rt-13b-q4","input":"short prompt"}'; echo; done
```
This produces intermittent 429s after ~80 concurrent calls locally matching their pattern.\
mike-sre: Copying logs: 
```
2026-03-17T06:12:05Z autoscaler: pool=dp-glide-1 desired=6 -> provision(2)
2026-03-17T06:14:10Z autoscaler: pool=dp-glide-1 desired=4 -> deprovision(2) reason=idle_timeout
2026-03-17T06:16:20Z autoscaler: pool=dp-glide-1 desired=6 -> provision(2)
```
You can see the +2/-2 pattern. Idle timeout is 90s for this pool.\
anya-eng: Proposed quick mitigations:
- increase idle_timeout/cooldown to 600s for dp-glide-1 (temporarily)
- set min_replicas=4 to avoid scale-to-low during bursts
- enable smoothing window to 120s and use 75th percentile for cpu/latency signals
These reduce oscillation while we root cause noisy tenant behavior.\
mike-sre: I can apply a staging change to the pool's autoscaler config and monitor for 30m. If stable, promote to prod. Who owns change approval?\
sam-customer-success: I'll notify GlidePay we plan a temporary config change to stabilize their pool and will monitor impact. They asked for a heads-up before changes.\
deploy-bot: Recent deploy detected to runtime service at 05:58 UTC (build b-20260317-058). No immediate errors in rollout logs.\
jess-oncall: Plan: mike will patch dp-glide-1 autoscaler -> cooldown/idle_timeout=600s, min_replicas=4, smoothing_window=120s. Monitor 06:30-07:00 UTC and report. If no improvement, escalate to eng-runtime for kernel warmup investigation. sam will inform customer. anya will prepare follow-up to audit tenant request patterns for noisy workloads.\
mike-sre: Applying change now on staging then will flip on prod after smoke. Will post prometheus dashboards links and raw autoscaler events here.\
jess-oncall: Thx. Opened support ticket INC-2025 and assigned to mike-sre / anya-eng. I'll update ticket with request IDs and customer logs. :thumbsup:\
sam-customer-success: Customer acknowledged and appreciates the quick turnaround. Will flag if they see anything else.\
mike-sre: Change applied to prod at 06:26 UTC. Early sign: no scale-down events from 06:26-06:38, 429s dropped to 0. Monitoring until 07:00. Will add a follow-up doc with tuning knobs and postmortem if needed.\
jess-oncall: Great. Leave thread open until 07:00 and then we can close with summary.
